relationships.subject: chronic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Chronic pain has been associated with activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis and the sympathetic-adrenal axis

relationships.subject: chronic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Continuous pain conditions trigger inflammatory pathways in which circulating levels of cytokines such as interleukin (IL)-1β and IL-6 and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) are raised

key_findings: Narrative review linking chronic pain to HPA/sympathetic activation, systemic inflammation and epigenetic remodeling driving cardiometabolic dysfunction.
